name: nazdik-store
description: Hyperlocal multi-vendor marketplace for the Iranian market

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@nazdik/shared && npm run build --workspace=@nazdik/api && npm run build --workspace=@nazdik/web
scripts.test: node apps/api/test/run-phase1.cjs && node apps/api/test/run-phase2.cjs && node apps/api/test/run-phase3.cjs && node apps/api/test/run-phase4.cjs && node apps/api/test/run-phase5.cjs
scripts.test:api: node apps/api/test/run-phase1.cjs && node apps/api/test/run-phase2.cjs && node apps/api/test/run-phase3.cjs && node apps/api/test/run-phase4.cjs && node apps/api/test/run-phase5.cjs
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=@nazdik/api && npm run lint --workspace=@nazdik/web
